judgment: It is not good for the noble one to hold firm.
The great goes, the small comes.
image: Heaven and earth do not meet: Blocked.
So the noble one keeps virtue spare and avoids trouble,
and will not take honour in salary.
lines: Pulling couch grass by the roots,
Holding firm: good — it goes through.
For the great person: blocked — and through.
There is a charge: no harm.
It could go! It could go! —
tie it to the mulberry clump.

notes.name_en: 否 is passage shut; paired with 11 Flowing.
notes.L5: 其亡其亡 the anxious doubling kept as an exclamation; 苞桑 mulberry with clustered roots.
